rawFailureExplanation.reason: The predicate rejects any accepted generation sharing guidanceId, including immutable warmup primary1 generation already completed/published before primary3.

The predicate rejects any same-guidanceId evidence or supplement anywhere in the stream. One retained warmup evidence row and frame7 warmup supplement satisfy it before target frame8. Neither is a late target output.

hardGaps: Only supplied snapshots/SSE/DB projections are classified; future publication and full HTTP completion are not inferred.
Raw wire bytes, provenance file hashes and original artifact immutability are caller-owned verification; this function performs no I/O.
Recorded elapsed time does not prove cancellation at exactly 5000 ms or every application timer/listener cleanup.
Upstream completion followed by downstream abort cannot establish cancellation of active inference; 30-cycle cleanup is not demonstrated.
Rendered visibility, physical audio, duplicate publication and subsequent primary transition require separate evidence.
Target fallback has no persisted provider completion join; capture association uses one-shot ID and chronological phase evidence.
